messages:
rita (partnerships): Quick sync: proposing a version-gate for partner SDKs that call the marketplace adapter API. goal: avoid silent breaks when we remove deprecated fields. want partner opt-in flow + migration helpers.

omar (eng-platform): What does the gate look like? header-based opt-in, or runtime feature flag from marketplace?

rita (partnerships): Two-part: 1) header `X-Redwood-Compat: v2` partners set when they accept new response fields; 2) marketplace will advertise supported compat versions. We'll warn if adapter speaks older version.

jess (partner-eng): Partners will want a compatibility bridge. can eng-sdks provide a shim that maps v2 fields into v1 if needed?

paul (eng-sdks): Yes. plan: SDK shim v1->v2 translator that can be toggled. we'll ship as a separate small package to avoid bumping main SDK for everyone. docs + examples included.

neela (legal): Make sure deprecation timelines are in partner agreements. if the header enables behavior change, we need to call that out. recommend 90-day soft-warning + 180-day enforcement.

omar (eng-platform): Implementation notes: the gateway will check header and route to the compatible backend. if header absent and the adapter is known older, we return a deprecation warning in `response.metadata.deprecation` and include `compat_advice` URL.

ci-bot: New pipeline: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/compat-gate-35000 created. nightly smoke runs scheduled.

jess (partner-eng): I'll send a partner preview tonight with the header spec, example curl, and the shim package link. Also call out rollback steps.

paul (eng-sdks): Example snippet for partners:
```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Compat: v2" \
  -d '{"req":{}}' \
  https://adapter.partner/api/endpoint
```
SDK shim usage: `npm i @redwood/adapter-compat && require('adapter-compat').enable('v2')`

rita (partnerships): Checklist:
- partner preview (jess)
- SDK shim package (paul)
- gateway header support + deprecation warnings (omar)
- legal deprecation text (neela)

rita (partnerships): timeline: preview this week, soft-warning in 90d, enforcement in 180d. flag any partner needs for longer runway. :sparkles:
